bibliography.title: Acid-in-Clay Electrolyte for Wide-Temperature-Range   and Long-Cycle Proton Batteries

mechanism_relevant_findings: The acid-in-clay electrolyte (AiCE) integrates fast proton carriers within a natural clay network to facilitate proton transport.
Proton conductivities of AiCE were measured to be 15 mS cm−1 at 25 °C and 0.023 mS cm−1 at −82 °C.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study provides meaningful insights into proton conduction mechanisms and the benefits of the AiCE system.
